test.//: Recognition of a generated scanned PDF: its text, the same in any order and in any worker, and the same as the text it was pinned with (test/fixtures/expected.text.json). No build target: whoever uses it compiles the source.

recognize.//: Recognizes a PDF's textless pages and writes its text file beside it: `nx run @chaoticgoodcomputing/pdf-ocr:recognize --args=<file.pdf>`.
